title: Bunny Companion session
description: The standing context a task is submitted into: how private this work is, how much it may cost, and whether any of it may leave the device. Asked once per session so that consent does not become a reflex answered per task. This document is a projection of the session's event stream and can always be rebuilt from it; where the two disagree the stream is authoritative. It contains no credentials, no authentication state and nothing that identifies the machine.

sessionId.description: Restricted because it becomes a directory name; an identifier containing a path separator is a traversal waiting for somewhere to happen.

completedTaskIds.description: "No longer running", which covers failure and cancellation. A task cannot appear in both lists.

privacyPolicy.description: Defaults are the strict end. A session created without an explicit policy treats its content as personal and permits nothing off-device.

maximumRemoteClassification.description: Cannot be secret: secret data never leaves the device, so there is no way to express that it may.

costPolicy.description: Whole currency minor units. Zero means nothing may be spent, which is not the same as no limit — there is deliberately no way to express "unlimited", because a spend authorised by omission is not an authorisation.

localityPreference.description: The capability router's own vocabulary, unchanged, so a preference set here reaches the router without a translation that could be wrong.

selectedExecutor.description: Advisory only. Every task re-runs the capability check; a session that pinned an executor would keep using it after the machine stopped being able to.

capabilityPlanReference.description: Fingerprint of the capability plan the last decision in this session was made against.

eventStreamRevision.description: Sequence number of the last event written. Compared against the stream's tip on load; a disagreement means the process died between the append and this write, and the stream wins.
